podcast.title: Updating Psychedelic Sounds
podcast.body: Neo-Psych emerged in the post-punk world as bands mined the psychedelic sounds of the late 1960s and early 1970s, updating them with new gear and a punk-influenced attitude. It manifested in both British and American forms, the latter known as the Paisley Underground. "We call this Neo-Syke, which came in many different flavors in your or two."
